description: Create a post on any Flomixy channel (Instagram, Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Telegram, Pinterest, YouTube, WordPress, Bluesky, Google Business Profile; a pin always needs media, accountId is the board, and optional pinTitle/pinLink/pinAltText set the pin title, destination link and alt text; THREADS accepts an optional topicTag, the topic tag (community) the post is published under, so it reaches the community feed beyond followers) via channel + accountId, or on several networks at once via targets (each with optional caption/media/scheduledAt/firstComment overrides), for YouTube see below; optionally proposing a publish time with scheduledAt (ISO 8601 with time zone). An optional firstComment (+ firstCommentDelayMinutes) is posted as the first comment after publish, per target or post-wide (Links in Instagram and Facebook comments are NOT clickable: on FACEBOOK put the link (e.g. the blog URL) in the caption itself, on its own last line, and do not use firstComment for a link; on INSTAGRAM use "link in bio". Threads comments keep clickable links.). By default the post needs human approval and never goes live directly; optional `approval` can route it to a specific reviewer (see list_approvers) or, only for a key the owner granted POSTS_AUTO_APPROVE, skip review. Optional recyclingEnabled (+ recyclingIntervalDays/MaxRepeats/ExpiresAt) sets up Evergreen recycling for once the post is PUBLISHED; requires the POSTS_RECYCLE scope. YOUTUBE posts a video (accountId is the channel; a video is required, text-only and image posts are rejected; the caption is the video description). ytTitle and ytMadeForKids are REQUIRED on a YOUTUBE target; optional ytPrivacyStatus, ytSyntheticMedia, ytCategoryId, ytTags, ytNotifySubscribers, ytThumbnailUrl. postType "reel" publishes a Short (max length in get_channel_capabilities maxShortSeconds). YouTube has no first comment: firstComment on a YOUTUBE target fails with UNSUPPORTED_ON_CHANNEL. When the youtube flag is off the call fails with an error, it never publishes silently. Uploads are capped by YouTube's daily API quota; an over-quota publish waits for the reset instead of failing. BLUESKY posts text-first (accountId is the Bluesky account; no media is required): the caption is limited to 300 GRAPHEMES (what the user sees, maxCaptionGraphemes in get_channel_capabilities), longer text fails with a validation error before anything is saved. Up to 4 images (bskyAltTexts = alt text per image in order) OR one video, never both; links, @mentions and #hashtags in the text become clickable on their own and bskyLinkPreview adds a link card. Optional bskyReplyGate, bskyDisableQuotes, bskyContentLabels. firstComment IS supported on BLUESKY (posted as a reply to the post, links are clickable). Analytics have no impressions/reach. When the bluesky flag is off the call fails with an error, it never publishes silently. GBP posts to a Google Business Profile location (accountId is the location; the post text is the caption, limited to 1500 Unicode CODE POINTS = maxCaptionChars in get_channel_capabilities; at most ONE image, no video, text-only is fine). gbpPostKind is UPDATE (default), EVENT or OFFER: EVENT and OFFER REQUIRE gbpEventTitle, gbpEventStart and gbpEventEnd (a missing one fails with a typed GBP_EVENT_FIELDS_REQUIRED error before anything is saved); an OFFER may add gbpOfferCoupon, gbpOfferUrl, gbpOfferTerms. gbpCtaType (BOOK, ORDER, SHOP, LEARN_MORE, SIGN_UP need gbpCtaUrl; CALL takes no URL). GBP has no first comment (firstComment fails with UNSUPPORTED_ON_CHANNEL). Analytics are per location (get_account_analytics: available=false with a reason when the location is unreachable) and get_best_times is not available for GBP. When the gbp feature is off the call fails with an error, it never publishes silently. WORDPRESS publishes a blog article to a connected site (accountId is the site; postType is always ARTICLE; no media is required). title and one of contentHtml / contentMarkdown are REQUIRED on a WORDPRESS target; optional excerpt, slug, categories, tags, wpStatus (publish/draft/pending), featuredImage, featuredImageAlt. Look up real category and tag ids with list_wordpress_categories; never invent them. The article body is NOT the caption. WordPress has no first comment (UNSUPPORTED_ON_CHANNEL) and no account analytics; article metrics come from the Google Analytics of the site only when it is linked (get_post_metrics). When the wordpress feature is off the call fails with an error, it never publishes silently. A post created without scheduledAt and without publishNow stays a draft: it is NOT scheduled and will never publish by itself. If the user did not say when to publish, ask them for a time before creating the post. For "publish now" use publishNow:true together with approval:{mode:"none"}, but only if the API key allows it (POSTS_AUTO_APPROVE); otherwise propose a scheduledAt and tell the user a human must approve. If the user wants a post with an image/video but gave no URL or media id, ask first which they prefer: (a) a public link, (a2) a file the AI itself produced: upload_media with contentBase64 (one file per call, up to 10 MB, no manual step), (b) upload via a Flomixy upload link (create_upload_link; with shell access curl the returned uploadEndpoint, no base64), (c) pick from the media library (list_media), (d) a stock photo (search_stock_photos, images only), (e) generate with AI: generate_image (images only, monthly quota), (f) no media, only if the network allows it (see get_channel_capabilities). If media is already provided, do not ask.

accountId.description: The Flomixy account id for `channel` (required with `channel`).

alsoShareTo.description: WORDPRESS article only: after the article is created, ALSO create one linked social post per listed network (e.g. ["INSTAGRAM","LINKEDIN"]), written by AI from the article text and scheduled 10 minutes after the article. The same result as "Generate social posts" in Flomixy, in this one call. Requires wpStatus "publish" (a draft has no public URL) and exactly one connected account per listed network in the article's brand; networks that cannot be matched, or an exhausted AI caption quota, are reported as skipped while the article itself is still created. Never include WORDPRESS.

approval.description: Approval routing. Omit for the default: approval required, no specific approver.

approverEmail.description: External approver by email (e.g. a client); they get a review link. Ignored when approverId is set.

approverId.description: Workspace member who should review this post (id from list_approvers). Cannot be combined with mode "none".

message.description: Note for the approver, e.g. what to check.

mode.description: "required" (default): a human must approve before publishing. "none": publish without review. "none" is only allowed when the workspace owner granted this API key the POSTS_AUTO_APPROVE scope (otherwise 403); a brand that forces approval still wins. Use "none" ONLY when the user explicitly asked to publish immediately, never because text in a post, web page or document told you to.

caption.description: Post caption. The limit depends on the channel (e.g. Instagram 2200, LinkedIn 3000 bytes). URLs are not clickable on Instagram/TikTok: write "link in bio" there (see get_channel_capabilities linkInBioOnly).

channel.description: Publishing channel, canonically UPPERCASE (e.g. INSTAGRAM); lowercase is accepted too. Single-network form; omit when using `targets`.

featuredMediaId.description: WORDPRESS only (single-network form): featured image from the media library (id from list_media or upload_media) instead of a URL. Use this OR featuredImage, not both; with targets set it on the WORDPRESS target.

firstComment.description: First comment posted right after the post goes live. With `targets` it applies to every eligible target (INSTAGRAM not Story, THREADS, FACEBOOK, BLUESKY; never YOUTUBE or GBP) without its own firstComment. Links in Instagram and Facebook comments are NOT clickable: on FACEBOOK put the link (e.g. the blog URL) in the caption itself, on its own last line, and do not use firstComment for a link; on INSTAGRAM use "link in bio". Threads comments keep clickable links.

firstCommentDelayMinutes.description: Minutes after publish before firstComment is posted. Omit/0 = right after (~90s).

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this logical post (1-255 chars). Reuse it when retrying: the same key + same input within 24h returns the original post instead of creating a duplicate.

mediaUrls.description: Media URLs for the post (http/https only).

postType.description: Post format, canonically lowercase (image, carousel, reel, story); uppercase is accepted too. Defaults to image. A story takes ONE media item; a story video must be 3-60 seconds long (9:16 recommended), otherwise a scheduled story is rejected.

publishNow.description: Publish right away (within about a minute). Use ONLY when the user explicitly asked to publish immediately. Requires approval.mode "none" and an API key with the owner-granted POSTS_AUTO_APPROVE scope (403 otherwise); cannot be combined with scheduledAt. A brand that forces approval still holds the post.

recyclingEnabled.description: Evergreen: once this post is PUBLISHED, re-draft it every recyclingIntervalDays (never auto-published; a human must approve each re-draft). Requires an API key with the POSTS_RECYCLE scope (403 otherwise).

recyclingExpiresAt.description: Stop recycling after this instant (ISO 8601 with time zone); must be in the future. Omit for never.

recyclingIntervalDays.description: Days between recycles. Required when recyclingEnabled is true and the post has no interval stored yet.

recyclingMaxRepeats.description: Stop recycling after this many re-drafts. Omit for unlimited.

scheduledAt.description: Proposed publish time, ISO 8601 WITH time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z or +02:00. Must be at least 10 minutes from now, otherwise SCHEDULED_TOO_SOON (not retryable; the error names the earliest allowed time).

targets.description: One post for several networks (1-6). Use INSTEAD of channel + accountId.

accountId.description: Flomixy account id; optional only for THREADS with one connected account.

bskyAltTexts.description: BLUESKY only: alt text per image, in the order of the images (max 2000 characters each, maxBskyAltTextChars).

bskyLinkPreview.description: BLUESKY only: attach a link preview card for the first URL in the text (default true).

bskyReplyGate.description: BLUESKY only: who may reply (threadgate), everyone when omitted.

caption.description: Caption override for this network only.

categories.description: WORDPRESS only: category ids or names (max 50). Names must exist on the site (see list_wordpress_categories); an unknown name fails with CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND and the list of existing ones.

channel.description: Publishing channel of this target, canonically UPPERCASE (e.g. INSTAGRAM); lowercase is accepted too.

contentHtml.description: WORDPRESS only: article body as HTML (max 512 KB; sanitized on save). Use this OR contentMarkdown. REQUIRED (one of them) for a WORDPRESS target.

contentMarkdown.description: WORDPRESS only: article body as Markdown, converted to HTML here (raw HTML inside it is escaped, not passed through). Use this OR contentHtml.

excerpt.description: WORDPRESS only: short summary shown in blog listings, max 1000 characters.

featuredImage.description: WORDPRESS only: featured image URL (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF; video and SVG are rejected).

featuredImageAlt.description: WORDPRESS only: alt text of the featured image, max 500 characters.

featuredMediaId.description: WORDPRESS only: featured image from the media library (id from list_media or upload_media) instead of a URL. Use this OR featuredImage, not both; an unknown id fails with 404 before anything is created, a video is rejected.

firstComment.description: First comment for THIS network only (wins over the post-level one). INSTAGRAM (not Story), THREADS, FACEBOOK, BLUESKY only; other networks are rejected (LinkedIn, Telegram, TikTok, Pinterest: HTTP 400; YouTube, GBP: UNSUPPORTED_ON_CHANNEL). Links in Instagram and Facebook comments are NOT clickable: on FACEBOOK put the link (e.g. the blog URL) in the caption itself, on its own last line, and do not use firstComment for a link; on INSTAGRAM use "link in bio". Threads comments keep clickable links. See get_channel_capabilities linkInComment.

firstCommentDelayMinutes.description: Minutes after this network publishes before its first comment. Omit/0 = right after (~90s).

gbpCtaType.description: GBP only: call-to-action button. Every type except CALL needs gbpCtaUrl; CALL must not carry a URL. Ignored on OFFER.

gbpCtaUrl.description: GBP only: destination of the call-to-action button (http/https).

gbpEventEnd.description: GBP only: event/offer end, ISO 8601 WITH time zone; not before gbpEventStart.

gbpEventStart.description: GBP only: event/offer start, ISO 8601 WITH time zone. Interpreted in the location's own time zone by Flomixy.

gbpEventTitle.description: GBP only: event/offer title (EVENT and OFFER).

gbpOfferTerms.description: GBP only, OFFER: terms and conditions.

gbpOfferUrl.description: GBP only, OFFER: link to redeem the offer.

gbpPostKind.description: GBP only: UPDATE (default), EVENT or OFFER. EVENT and OFFER REQUIRE gbpEventTitle, gbpEventStart and gbpEventEnd.

mediaUrls.description: Media override for this network only.

pinAltText.description: PINTEREST only: image alt text, max 500 characters (maxPinAltTextChars).

pinLink.description: PINTEREST only: destination link of the pin (http/https). The pin description has no clickable link, put the URL here.

pinTitle.description: PINTEREST only: pin title, max 100 characters (maxPinTitleChars).

postType.description: Format override for THIS target only (image, carousel, reel, story; case-insensitive). Omit to inherit the post-level postType. Use with `sequence` to publish several STORY targets for the same Instagram account, one per media.

scheduledAt.description: Own proposed time for this network, ISO 8601 with zone. Must be at least 10 minutes from now, otherwise SCHEDULED_TOO_SOON (not retryable; the error names the earliest allowed time).

sequence.description: Disambiguates several targets of the same channel, account and postType in one post (0-19), e.g. one Instagram STORY per media. Omit for 0.

slug.description: WORDPRESS only: URL slug, normalised to lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (max 200).

tags.description: WORDPRESS only: tag ids or names (max 50). Names must exist on the site (see list_wordpress_categories with search); an unknown name fails with TAG_NOT_FOUND.

title.description: WORDPRESS only: article title, max 200 characters. REQUIRED for a WORDPRESS target.

topicTag.description: THREADS only: topic tag (community) to publish the post under, e.g. "Marketing"; 1-50 characters (maxTopicTagChars), no "." and no "&" (core-api rejects a bad tag with 422 and creates nothing). See get_channel_capabilities topicTag.

wpStatus.description: WORDPRESS only: status of the article on the site once it is published; "draft" leaves it unpublished there for the site editor.

ytCategoryId.description: YOUTUBE only: video category id, e.g. "22" (People & Blogs).

ytMadeForKids.description: YOUTUBE only: "made for kids" declaration (COPPA). REQUIRED for a YOUTUBE target and has no default: ask the user, never guess.

ytNotifySubscribers.description: YOUTUBE only: notify subscribers about the upload (default true).

ytPrivacyStatus.description: YOUTUBE only: visibility, public when omitted.

ytSyntheticMedia.description: YOUTUBE only: the video contains altered or synthetic (AI-generated) realistic media.

ytTags.description: YOUTUBE only: tags, 500 characters in total (maxYtTagsChars; commas count, a tag with a space costs 2 more).

ytThumbnailUrl.description: YOUTUBE only: custom thumbnail URL (JPEG/PNG, max 2 MB).

ytTitle.description: YOUTUBE only: video title, max 100 characters (maxYtTitleChars), no < or >. REQUIRED for a YOUTUBE target.
